title: Old New Orleans, Miss Young and Henry Young, first bands on the Gulf Coast
summary: He recalls the city before cars, practising in the shoe store, his father's death, learning to fake with the Youngs, and forming his first groups in Long Beach and New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons
